messages:
carol_devex: Quick reproducible bug I'm seeing in the py async client: Authorization header disappears on a replay after a 502 + timeout interplay. Broke a sample app flow this morning.

alice_eng: ugh. which retry policy are you using? auto or custom?

carol_devex: auto by default. minimal repro below — single file sample app that hits our hosted endpoint, triggers a 502 then client retries and replay request lacks auth.

carol_devex: ```python
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def main():
    client = AsyncClient(api_key="sk-test-...", retry_policy="default", timeout=2.0)
    # create is non-idempotent in our sample app
    resp = await client.post("/v1/sample/create", json={"name":"test"}, headers={"Idempotency-Key":"abc-1"})
    print(await resp.json())

asyncio.run(main())
```

ben_infra: can you paste the raw transport logs? also which SDK version?

carol_devex: SDK 0.9.4-rc3. logs:

```
-> POST /v1/sample/create
-> Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-test-...
<- 502 Bad Gateway
Retrying (attempt 2)...
-> POST /v1/sample/create
-> Headers: Idempotency-Key: abc-1
<- 201 Created
```

carol_devex: note Authorization header present on initial req, missing on retry. caused duplicate records in the sample app because backend considered it unauthenticated fallback and created a new resource.

alice_eng: workaround: set client.session.headers["Authorization"] or pass auth via transport-level config so retries inherit it. not ideal tho.

eva_pm: is this causing customer-facing duplicates or just dev sample? any P0?

carol_devex: customer-facing for one pilot yesterday. they hit duplicates on create endpoints.

ben_infra: thanks for repro. looks like our retry wrapper reconstructs the request from saved body/headers but strips per-request auth header if it came from the auth plugin. I'll add a failing unit test and a fix to preserve auth when rebuilding replay requests. also needs a test for timeout propagation so cancel/timeout prevents retry.

carol_devex: can we also add a convenience per-request param e.g. idempotency_key= to the client helper so users don't have to manually set headers every time? would reduce accidental duplicates. :pray:

alice_eng: created GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/1234 for auth-on-retry + idempotency helper. adding patch branch.

deploy-bot: Note: canary deploy for the fix scheduled for 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC (will include transport auth-preserve and timeout propagation tests)

ben_infra: @carol_devex can you drop the minimal sample app link and CI repro in the issue? that'll speed review.

carol_devex: done — added the tiny repro and logs to #1234. thanks all! :thumbsup:
